records.summary: 2026-27 catalog: UT Knoxville dual enrollment courses are recorded on the UT transcript, are not transfer credit, and count in the UTK GPA. Dual enrollment taken at other institutions is transfer credit evaluated under standard transfer policy and does not count in the UTK GPA. UT dual enrollment applicants should have a minimum 3.0 high school GPA; admission is not guaranteed. For transfer-admission review, dual enrollment hours do not count toward transferable-hour thresholds but grades are factored into the transfer GPA. UT weights dual enrollment courses +1.0 quality point in the UT Core GPA.
